title: Writing / Voice / Expressive
slide_intent: Express enthusiasm with clarity and restraint so encouragement does not become pressure or confusion.
strategic_value: Contrasts between brief, active examples and weaker alternatives can help Duolingo make energy useful to learners.
demonstration: The left column defines Expressive through positive and negative traits; five right-hand comparisons cover brevity, active voice, directness, excitement and notifications.
practical_value: Edit a message toward clear action and measured excitement using the paired alternatives.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Expressive heading, rationale and two trait lists at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack five comparison rows at right, marking preferred examples with green checks and placing the alternatives underneath.

reference_purposes.Intent: The explanation links expressive writing to excitement about helping people learn.
reference_purposes.Expression: Brief celebratory and instructional examples demonstrate the voice.
reference_purposes.Application: Five paired comparisons show how to change wording.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page rejects unclear, indifferent, long-winded and intrusive language.

ingredient.name: Expressive voice
ingredient.application: Favor brief, active, direct encouragement; avoid pressure in notifications.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
